senses.gloss:
m. (-सः)
A male actor or dancer in female apparel.
E.
भ्रु an eye-brow, कुसि to speak, aff. अच्, रु changed to ऋ; also with कन् added भृकुंसक, and रु unchanged भ्रकुंस; also from कुशि, भृकुंश, &c.

f. (-टिः-टी)
A frown, a contraction of the brows.
E.
भ्रु the eye-brow, कुट to be or make crooked, aff. कि, and ङीप् optionally added, भृ substituted for भ्रु; otherwise भ्रुकुटि, भ्रुकुटी, &c.
